simplificandoai.title: SimplificandoAI
simplificandoai.description: AI-powered marketing automation platform. Creates sensory copy and visuals with Vision AI and schedules Instagram posts automatically.
highlights: Vision AI for contextual image analysis and high-converting copy
Automated Instagram scheduling and publishing workflow

chatAssistant.title: InterasisAI Connect
chatAssistant.description: Intelligent agent grounded in customer knowledge base ingestion. Provides 24/7 zero-hallucination support, handles scheduling, and embeds directly via Web Widget and official WhatsApp.
chatAssistant.impactText: Not just a chatbot with canned replies. It's the service architecture that understands your customer's business before the first message — and never leaves anyone stuck in a menu.
highlights: Zero-hallucination responses grounded in custom RAG ingestion
Embeddable floating Web Widget for client websites
Automated appointment scheduling integrated with Google Calendar

feijoadaDelivery.title: Delivery Platform
feijoadaDelivery.description: Complete ordering system for a delivery service, with real-time order and inventory management via WebSockets. Mobile and web apps designed to simplify the customer journey, from order to delivery.
highlights: Real-time order and inventory management via WebSockets
Mobile and web apps (React, React Native) with a simplified ordering flow
Interface and flow redesign via Figma, reducing friction in the purchase process

dataDashboard.title: Data-Driven Dashboard Engine
dataDashboard.description: Corporate data visualization system that consumes information from external systems and dynamically renders dashboards from JSON configuration, with an AI layer to automatically consolidate large volumes of documents.
highlights: JSON schema-configurable dashboard engine, consuming data from external systems
Python AI layer for automatic consolidation of over 7,000 documents
Decoupled architecture (Clean Architecture/SOLID) in Node.js and NestJS

metalsCatalog.title: Smart Catalog for the Metals Industry
metalsCatalog.description: Self-managed product catalog system for a metalworking industry company, giving the sales team real-time access to stock and pricing, with serverless AWS infrastructure for fast media delivery.
highlights: Self-managed product catalog with real-time stock and pricing
Custom admin panel for managing media and descriptions
Serverless AWS infrastructure (Lambda + S3 + CloudFront) for high performance

eventsPlatform.title: Wedding & Event Management Platform
eventsPlatform.description: Management modules for a wedding and event platform serving the US market, with real-time theme customization and data synchronization via GraphQL.
highlights: Real-time theme switcher for personalized user experience
Guest, vendor, and event timeline management modules
GraphQL (Apollo) architecture for real-time data synchronization
